submit.title: Submit a Resolution
submit.introText: Thank you for preparing a resolution for the Río Texas Annual Conference. This guided process will walk you through submitting your proposal into the system.
submit.processStep1: Your resolution is received by the Conference Secretary.
submit.processStep2: It is assigned to the appropriate committee for review.
submit.processStep3: The committee makes a recommendation to the Uniting Table.
submit.processStep4: The Uniting Table decides whether to include it in the pre-conference journal.
submit.beforeYouStartText: You should have already discussed your resolution with the Assistant to the Bishop before submitting it here. If you haven't, please reach out to their office first.
submit.need2: The full text (WHEREAS clauses and RESOLVED clauses)
submit.need3: A brief rationale explaining why this resolution matters
submit.accountExplanation: Create an account so you can track your resolution's progress. If you already have an account, enter your email and password and click 'Existing Account'.
submit.name: Full Name
submit.writeExplanation: You may write in English, Spanish, or both. At least one language is required for the title and text.
submit.reviewExplanation: Please review your resolution carefully. Once submitted, it cannot be edited.
submit.submitted: Your resolution has been submitted! You will receive a resolution number.
submit.needTitle: Please enter a title in at least one language.
submit.needText: Please enter the resolution text in at least one language.
